problem_type: Walkthrough seeds claim to be current-format projects but lack fields that a background writer fills after open, so before/after graph comparisons race it
symptom: Canvas Acceptance (Linux) (2) failed on PR #1234 (no canvas code changed): canvas-shortcuts 「Prompt Delete preserves graph/result/binding state」 received an extra previewState: 'source' on result and history.
direct_cause: Since 24c7509aa (2026-10-16) resultMediaBackfillBridge writes previewState onto local image/video results lacking a preview fact, after open once the canvas is quiet. The C19 seed results had no preview fact, so whether the backfill landed between promptBefore and the post-Delete snapshot was timing-dependent.
class_root: Walk seeds that assert 'opening / this gesture does not change the graph' have no check that they really are current-format; when the current format grows a background-filled field, those seeds silently become legacy and their equality assertions flake.

invariant_owner_layer.why: assertCurrentFormatCanvasSeed judges seeds with the production predicates shouldBackfillPreview / shouldRelocalizeResult, so a seed that a background writer would rewrite fails at setup.

affected_population: Electron walkthroughs that seed canvas results and compare graph or result snapshots across time
entry_points: Walk seed construction passed to createWorkspaceProject
internal_only_reason: Both the writer (resultMediaBackfillBridge) and the seeds are ours.
invariants: A seed used for before/after equality contains no entry that a post-open background writer would rewrite

door_reduction.why_not: The background writer must keep existing (it repairs legacy projects); the seed check reads its predicate rather than copying it, so both doors stay.

generality_proof: The seed check uses the writer's own predicates, so it tracks the writer exactly; adding the next background-filled field means adding its predicate in one shared helper, and every walk calling the helper fails at setup instead of flaking.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Rejects seeds that post-open background writers would rewrite.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Seed results carry previewState 'source' and pass assertCurrentFormatCanvasSeed.
Snapshots the unrelated node's result (line ~116) and deep-compares later; seed now carries previewState and is checked.
Its equality assertions compare meta and drag state, not results.

recurrence.reason: The current format keeps evolving with background repairs (version numbers, preview facts, relocalization); every evolution can turn existing seeds legacy.
same_class_scan: grep createWorkspaceProject walks that also assert diskGraph / toEqual(before) / isDeepStrictEqual → canvas-shortcuts, core-a-storyboard-undo, core-a-composer

prevention.invariant: Seeds passed to assertCurrentFormatCanvasSeed contain no entry for which shouldBackfillPreview or shouldRelocalizeResult is true.
prevention.failure_mode: The walk throws at setup naming each offending node entry.
prevention.strategy: Judge seeds with the production writer's predicates in one shared helper.

legacy_paths.rationale: No old path; seeds are corrected in place.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party dependency controls this invariant; it is between our own CSS / background writer and our own test fixtures.

migration: None: seeds are created per run.
residual_risks: Walks that seed results but do not call the helper are still unchecked; only the two with result equality assertions were migrated.
